common.title: Your data
common.intro: Here you can get a copy of your data, ask for your data to be erased, or close your account, and follow each request.
common.signin: Sign in to see and make requests about your data.
common.script_note: This page works without JavaScript. With JavaScript turned on, a page you leave is hidden when you come back to it and is loaded again.

scope.session_tenant: These requests concern your membership across this whole institution, as you are signed in now.
scope.session_organization: These requests concern your membership in the branch you are signed in to now. To make a request about another branch, switch to that branch first.
scope.entry_intro: Your membership here is suspended or has ended. You can still get a copy of your data, ask for erasure, close your account and follow your requests. First choose where your request applies.
scope.entry_names: Branch names cannot be shown here. Branches are always listed in the same order.
scope.entry_empty: No membership or request was found for this account in this institution, so there is nothing to show here.
scope.entry_selected_tenant: Requests for this institution as a whole
scope.entry_selected_organization: Requests for one branch of this institution

result.title: Done
result.export: Your request for a copy of your data has been recorded. It usually takes a few minutes; this page shows when the file is ready.
result.erasure: Your erasure request has been recorded. It starts after 24 hours, and you can cancel it until then.
result.closure: Your account closure request has been recorded. Before anything happens, an operator contacts you by e-mail to confirm it. You can cancel it until the operator begins.
result.cancelled: The request has been cancelled. Nothing was changed.
result.revoked: The file has been deleted. You can ask for a new copy whenever you need one.

export.title: Get a copy of your data
export.description: We prepare one file with the data this institution holds about you here: your membership and profile, the answers you gave and your consents, the invitations you received or sent (other people's addresses are left out), and records of activity that concern you.
export.audit_note: The activity records in the file are the ones this branch or institution can show. They are not your complete history across the institution.
export.timing: The file is usually ready within minutes. You can then download it for 7 days. Asking for a new copy deletes the previous file.
export.active: A copy is already being prepared. You can ask again once it is finished.

erasure.title: Erase your data here
erasure.summary: Erasure clears your profile and answers in this branch or institution and ends your membership here. Your account and your memberships elsewhere stay as they are.
erasure.active: An erasure is already scheduled or in progress. You can follow it in the list below.
erasure.erased_profile: Your name, your language and the answers you gave here are cleared.
erasure.erased_roles: Your roles here are removed and your membership here ends, so you lose access to this branch or institution.
erasure.erased_exports: Copies of your data that can still be downloaded are deleted, and a copy that is still being prepared is cancelled.
erasure.erased_invitations: Invitations you sent here that nobody has accepted yet are withdrawn.
erasure.kept_intro: Some records have to be kept. They no longer hold your name or your answers, but they still refer to you by an internal number:
erasure.kept_consent: the record of the consents you gave or withdrew, kept as evidence;
erasure.kept_invitations: the record of invitations you sent or accepted, including the e-mail address an invitation was sent to; an invitation sent to your e-mail address that you never accepted is kept too, but cannot be counted;
erasure.kept_audit: activity records: an operator removes your network address, your browser details and your e-mail address from them, and your receipt then shows how many records remain;
erasure.kept_attribution: notes of who created or last changed something here;
erasure.kept_uncounted: Some copies are kept but not counted: records of messages and background work, short-lived records of repeated submissions, delivery copies of e-mails, backups and the sign-in service's logs. The platform's retention rules remove them later.
erasure.kept_partial: So the list of what is kept is not complete: something that is not listed is not necessarily absent.
erasure.timing: Erasure starts 24 hours after you ask for it, and you can cancel it here until then. Once it has run, an operator completes the last step on the activity records.
erasure.confirm: I understand what is erased and what is kept, and that erasure cannot be undone once it starts.
erasure.back: Keep my data and go back

closure.title: Close your account
closure.summary: Closing your account ends it everywhere: in every institution and branch where you have a membership, not only here.
closure.start: See what closing your account means
closure.active: An account closure is already scheduled. You can follow it or cancel it in the list below.
closure.warning_everywhere: Your account ends in every institution and branch where you have a membership, not only here.
closure.warning_email: Before anything happens, an operator contacts you at the e-mail address of your sign-in account to confirm that you made this request.
closure.warning_cancel: Until the operator begins, you can cancel the request on this page.
closure.warning_stops: As soon as the operator begins, your account stops working. You cannot sign in again, and this cannot be undone.
closure.warning_no_status: From then on there is no page where you can follow the closure. The operator tells you by e-mail when it is complete.
closure.warning_data: Your data is then erased in each institution and branch, and your sign-in account is deleted. What is kept is the same as for an erasure, described below.
closure.confirm_irreversible: I understand that my account stops working everywhere and that this cannot be undone.
closure.confirm_no_status: I understand that no page to follow the closure remains once it begins.
closure.back: Keep my account and go back

list.title: Your requests
list.empty: You have not made any requests here yet.
list.by_administrator: An administrator of this institution made this request about you.
list.by_closure: This erasure is part of your account closure.

next.export_requested: We are preparing your file. This usually takes a few minutes; reload this page to check.
next.export_ready: Your file is ready. Download it before the date shown.
next.export_gone: This file can no longer be downloaded. Ask for a new copy if you need one.
next.erasure_scheduled: Erasure starts after the time shown. You can cancel it until then.
next.erasure_due: The waiting time has ended and erasure starts shortly. It can no longer be cancelled.
next.erasure_fulfilling: Your data here is being erased.
next.erasure_awaiting: Your data here has been erased. An operator now completes the last step on the activity records. You do not need to do anything.
next.erasure_completed: Erasure is complete. The list below shows what is kept.
next.closure_scheduled: An operator contacts you by e-mail to confirm before beginning, which is possible from the time shown. You can cancel until the operator begins.
next.closure_fulfilling: Your account closure has begun and cannot be undone.
next.blocked: This request was stopped because it could not go ahead. You can make a new request.
next.failed: This request could not be completed. You can make a new request.
next.cancelled: This request was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

last_refusal.blocked_window: An operator tried to begin before the waiting time had ended. Your request is still scheduled.
last_refusal.blocked_hold: Your request is on hold because the institution has to keep your data for now, for example for an open payment matter. It stays scheduled and you can cancel it.
last_refusal.blocked_last_administrator: You are the only administrator of an institution. Another administrator has to be appointed there before this can go ahead. Your request stays scheduled and you can cancel it.

failure.export_too_large: Your data was too large for one file. Contact the institution for help.
failure.execution_failed: Something went wrong while carrying out this request. You can make a new request.

artifact.download_hint: The file is a structured text file in JSON format. Each download is recorded.
artifact.delete_hint: Once deleted, nobody can download the file any more, including you.
artifact.truncated: Some parts of the file were shortened to keep it within its size limit:

retained.title: What is kept
retained.intro: These records are kept, with the numbers the institution could count:
retained.pending: The numbers of activity records appear once an operator completes the last step.
retained.partial: This list is not complete: something that is not listed is kept but not counted, which does not mean there is none. Records of messages and background work, short-lived records of repeated submissions, delivery copies of e-mails, backups and the sign-in service's logs are kept until the platform's retention rules remove them.
retained.audit_retention: The platform's rules set how long activity records are kept: 7 years for security records and for records of consent changes, and 2 years for most others. This removal is not automatic yet, so records can be kept for longer.

kind.consent_evidence: Records of consents you gave or withdrew
kind.invitation_record: Records of invitations you sent or accepted
kind.audit_actor_reference: Activity records of things you did
kind.unscoped_audit_rows: Activity records outside this branch that the request could not reach
kind.transport_evidence: Records of messages between parts of the platform
kind.attribution_reference: Notes of who created or changed something
kind.federation_actor_reference: Records of single sign-on set-up steps you took
kind.request_receipt: Data requests, files and download records
kind.external_copy: Copies outside the platform, such as e-mail delivery copies and backups
kind.unserved_group: Places that could not be processed and keep your data for now

refusal.request_already_active: You already have a request of this kind in progress here. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it, before making a new one.
refusal.blocked_hold: This cannot go ahead right now because the institution has to keep your data for the moment, for example for an open payment matter. Contact the institution if you have questions.
refusal.blocked_last_administrator: You are the only administrator of this institution. Another administrator has to be appointed before your data can be erased.
refusal.subject_export_available: A copy of the data is already available to download. A new copy can be requested once that file is deleted or no longer available.
refusal.subject_membership_current: This membership is still active or suspended. It has to end before an administrator can ask for its erasure.
refusal.data_export_unavailable: This file can no longer be downloaded. Ask for a new copy.
refusal.data_request_window_ended: The waiting time has ended and erasure has started, so it can no longer be cancelled.
refusal.data_request_not_cancellable: This request can no longer be cancelled: it has already started or ended.
refusal.subject_is_requester: Requests about your own data are made on your own data page.
refusal.snapshot_too_large: This request covers more memberships than one request can hold. Contact the institution for help.
refusal.data_export_ticket_limit: This file has been downloaded too often in a short time, or too often in total. Wait 15 minutes and try again; if it still does not work, ask for a new copy.
refusal.subject_not_admitted: Your account is being closed, so no new request can be made.

error.title: Your request could not be completed
error.input: The form could not be read. Go back to your data requests and try again.
error.confirmation: Tick every confirmation box to go ahead.
error.csrf: This page has expired. Go back to your data requests and try again.
error.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.not_found: This request or file could not be found. It may belong to another branch, or your access here has changed.
error.stale: This request has changed since you opened the page. Go back to see its current state.
error.in_progress: The same request is still being processed. Wait a moment, then go back to check.
error.key_reuse: This form was already used for a different request. Go back and try again.
error.outcome_unavailable: We could not confirm what happened to your earlier attempt. Go back and check your requests before trying again.
error.conflict: This request cannot go ahead in its current state. Go back to see its current state.
error.busy: There are too many requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unavailable: This service is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unconfirmed: We could not confirm whether your request was recorded. Go back and check your requests before trying again.
error.download: The download could not be started. Go back and try again.
